selection.rule: Traverse the locked 32K mixed-BPE vocabulary in learned token-ID order; exclude the shared special tokens and exact base-vocabulary collisions; append every remaining token without normalization.
selection.normalization: disabled for added tokens; preserve exact candidate surfaces
selection.collision_policy: exclude exact token-string matches in the base vocabulary
selection.special_token_policy: preserve base special tokens; never append candidate specials

model_interface.embedding_resize: append rows; original rows and token IDs remain unchanged
model_interface.initialization: mean of the original tokenizer subwords for each added surface
model_interface.output_head: initialize appended output rows with the same mean-subword rule; retain the controlled pipeline's untied input/output interface
